description: Check the things that quietly take a business offline: when the domain expires (RDAP), when the latest certificate issued for the site expires and who issued it (public Certificate Transparency logs), whether the site answers over HTTPS, DNS basics, and email security (SPF, DMARC and DKIM at common selectors). Returns each finding with pass, warn or fail and a plain fix. Public data only. Free, no key. Rate limited per connection.
